name: vue3-giant-tree-wasm
description: A WebAssembly-powered Vue 3 virtual tree for 100K–1M nodes, with virtual scrolling, smooth expand/collapse animations, MPTT-based operations, search, selection, and optional Web Worker support.

paragraphs: A WebAssembly-powered virtual tree component for Vue 3, built for 100K–1M-node datasets. Tree building, traversal, fuzzy search and check propagation run in AssemblyScript-compiled WASM, using MPTT for O(1) subtree checks and O(k) viewport slicing. Only the rows in view are rendered to the DOM, so interaction stays responsive at a million nodes.
Requirements — Vue ^3.4 (peer dependency) · a browser with WebAssembly and Web Worker support · Node ≥18 only for building from source. License — BSD-2-Clause.

A WebAssembly-powered virtual tree for Vue 3, designed for responsive interaction with 100K–1M-node datasets. The core tree algorithms are written in AssemblyScript and compiled to WASM, leveraging the MPTT (Modified Preorder Tree Traversal) data structure to achieve O(1) subtree checks and O(k) viewport slicing.
features: WASM-accelerated — tree building, traversal, fuzzy search and check propagation run in AssemblyScript-compiled WebAssembly
Virtual scrolling — only the rows in view are rendered to the DOM
MPTT — O(1) subtree checks, O(k) viewport slicing, O(subtree + log N) expand/collapse
Three selection modes — checkbox (multi-select), radio (single-select), click-to-select
Fuzzy search — keyword filtering with automatic ancestor chain completion
